scholarship_title: DAAD EPOS Scholarship: MSc Photogrammetry and Geoinformatics, Stuttgart University of Applied Sciences (HFT Stuttgart) (intake 2027/2028)
provider_organization: German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD), with Stuttgart University of Applied Sciences (HFT Stuttgart)
eligible_nationalities: Other developing countries on DAAD's EPOS (OECD-DAC) country list

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: No tuition fees for EPOS scholarship holders; registration or enrolment fees may still apply

stipend.notes: EUR 992 a month for graduates for the length of the course (18 months without a German course)

additional_benefits: Health, accident and personal liability insurance contributions
Travel allowance (unless paid by the home country or another funder)
Rent subsidy and family allowance in some cases

application_fee.notes: Not stated on the pages checked.

language_proficiency: English, as required by the course
eligibility_criteria.age_limit: None, but your latest degree should normally be no more than six years old
eligibility_criteria.work_experience_years: 2 (relevant work after the bachelor's degree, at the time of application)

required_documents.name: CV
required_documents.detail: Reverse chronological, no unexplained gaps, Europass format preferred

required_documents.name: Letter of motivation
required_documents.detail: One identical letter for all courses you apply to (max 3), explaining your choice and priority

required_documents.name: Recommendation letter from current employer
required_documents.detail: Official letterhead, signed, stamped and recently dated

required_documents.name: Certificates of employment
required_documents.detail: At least two years of relevant work after the bachelor's; ideally with a re-employment guarantee

required_documents.name: Degree certificates
required_documents.detail: Certified translation if not in English or German

required_documents.name: Full transcript of records
required_documents.detail: With an explanation of the grading system

preparation_alerts: Get an employer recommendation and employment certificates showing two years' work after your bachelor's
Apply directly to the course, not to DAAD; you can apply to up to three EPOS courses
Applications go to master-pg@hft-stuttgart.de with the course application form

criteria.criterion: Review by the course selection committee

criteria.notes: Telephone or online, for shortlisted candidates

selection_criteria.pass_rule: The course nominates candidates to DAAD, which makes the final award; most selection ends in March

verification_status.verification_notes: HFT Stuttgart lists 15 October for DAAD scholarship applicants (year before study); a 2027-specific notice was not found, so 15 Oct 2026 is inferred from the standing rule. HFT reports about 8 EPOS scholarships a year. Course length is 18 months per the DAAD list (HFT pages also mention three semesters). Shared EPOS rules from DAAD's database entry and FAQ (June 2026). Nigeria is on DAAD's EPOS country list, but that PDF is marked 'validity 2024-2025'.
